content_fixes.new: But then, right in the middle of all the weeping and repenting at the entrance of the main tent, one Israelite man brazenly brought a Midianite woman into his tent, right in front of Moses and everyone. content_fixes.reason: The original's flippant tone ('get this', 'no shame at all', 'With one move', 'whole disaster') trivializes a double killing and a plague that killed 24,000; rewritten with sober teen voice preserving all MSG v6-9 substance.
